_comment: Frozen RAG evaluation set (audit Phase 21, expanded session 4 to 40 questions). 'expected_doc_substr' matches Citation.document_title for retrieval scoring where a real gold document was confirmed by direct retrieval inspection against the live corpus (src/bearing_pdm/rag/corpus.py SOURCE_DOCUMENTS as of 2026-10-21: RULGuard Architecture, Product Requirements - bearing_pdm, Canonical Feature-Row Data Contract, Decisions and Conflict Resolutions, Dataset Compatibility, Dataset Audit, Milestones (M0-M9), Prediction Reliability, plus literature). 'should_abstain'=true means no citation should clear MIN_RELEVANCE_SCORE and the system should decline rather than answer. 'forbidden_claims' are substrings that must never appear.
